$comment: SECTION 9.12 - the circuits the game can load. Same data shape, so the physics/renderer/HUD do not care which one is up: C cycles, or pass ?track=<id>.

tracks.name: Apex Loop
tracks.description: The race circuit: 1125 m, a fast right hander, a hairpin with an oil slick on the exit and a wet section across the top. 32 gates, 3 surface patches.

tracks.name: Tuning Grounds
tracks.description: The 9.12 test track: a 240 m start/finish straight, a fast right, two linked S-curves, a hairpin with a gravel apron, a back straight with a gravel crossing, and a long constant-radius oval turn with a wet section. Everything a car can be asked to do, in a known order.
